# Equinox Investment Group

> Equinox Investment Group LLC is a venture builder founded in 2024 by Carlos de Ory. It designs, launches and operates its own internet companies on one shared engine of distribution, talent and capital. Fully remote, with bases in Madrid, Dubai and Sumba (Indonesia). Legal entity in Wyoming, USA.

Thirteen companies are live (November 2026), across real estate, legal and money, work, travel, creators and growth.

## Portfolio

- [Eco Beach City](https://ecobeachcity.com): a beach town in Sumba, Indonesia, one hour from Bali. Homes, cabins and founder seats. The group's physical asset.
- [RealHunt](https://realhunt.co): the best homes in every country, each scored from 70 to 98 and ranked best first.
- [Kolaboro](https://kolaboro.com): local agents who work for the buyer of property abroad, never the seller, and film every milestone on site.
- [JuriMatch](https://jurimatch.com): find no-win-no-fee lawyers and litigation funders.
- [Without Taxes](https://withouttaxes.com): a personal ranking of the best countries to live and run a company paying little or no tax.
- [ReelRole](https://reelrole.com): get hired through a 30 to 90 second video; companies pay only to unlock the candidates they want.
- [Jobersity](https://jobersity.com): an AI agent that finds jobs that fit you and prepares a tailored application for each.
- [Happy Low Cost](https://happylowcost.com): error fares and cheap flights from your airport, sent for free.
- [Top3Hotels](https://top3hotels.com): three hotels in every city: one budget, one best value, one luxury.
- [MejorCrucero](https://mejorcrucero.com): Spain's cruise comparison, with every offer and ship scored from 0 to 100.
- [KlipStay](https://klipstay.com): make short videos for hotels and travel brands and earn free stays.
- [Linkveo](https://linkveo.com): film a hotel, restaurant or spa and earn a commission when someone books.
- [Lead Pool Club](https://leadpoolclub.com): qualified B2B buyers at a fraction of the usual cost.

## How Equinox works

1. Find the wedge: only build where distribution, trust or AI changed the rules of a market.
2. Build in weeks: a small operator team on a shared technical and legal spine.
3. Distribute across the network: each launch starts with the audience of the rest of the portfolio.
4. Double down: capital and hiring follow the numbers; what doesn't work is retired.
